prompt:
You are a equity research analyst. Using only the information below and general knowledge predating 2026-05-14, give a 20-trading-day directional recommendation for the stock.
Valid answers (choose exactly one): BUY, HOLD, SELL.
Company information (as of 2026-05-14):
| Return 3m            | +25.7% |
| Return 1m            | +11.6% |
| Return 1w            | +2.7% |
| Range position (63d) | 83% |
| 21d realized vol     | 41% |
| Last close           | 248.82 |
Reason briefly in 1-3 sentences. Then, on a separate final line, output exactly:
DECISION: <one label>
raw_response:
The stock shows strong recent momentum (+25.7% over 3 months, +11.6% over 1 month, +2.7% over 1 week) with a high range-position (83% over 63 days) and elevated near-term volatility (21d vol ~41%), suggesting continued upside momentum but with potential for brief pullbacks. With a solid multi-week uptrend and recent outperformance, the risk-reward favors further gains over the next 20 trading days, though upside may be moderated by volatility.

DECISION: BUY
